name: Review risky AI agent tool actions before execution
outcome: High-risk AI agent tool actions receive a policy decision before they can change systems, expose sensitive data, or run untrusted commands.
description: For workflows that give AI agents tools and data access, check proposed actions against permissions before execution. Allowed actions proceed; actions outside policy are denied or sent for a human decision. Coverage depends on the action paths a system can inspect, and a review record alone is not proof that an action was blocked.
measures: share of high-risk tool actions checked before execution
time to decide actions needing human approval
